## Handoff between iPhone and iPad

- **Browsing:** your other device offers Starlight where you are: the same tab, PC and game page. Pick it up there and Starlight opens in the same place.
- **Streaming:** while you play, your other device offers the game. Pick it up there and this device stops streaming (the game keeps running on the PC) while the other one resumes it with its own settings: resolution, Mirror or External Display, Match TV Resolution. If the PC is still busy with the first device, it keeps trying for up to about 10 seconds. If the PC is no longer running that game, the game's page opens instead, and if the other device isn't paired with that PC, it says so.
- Only the tab, PC and game travel between devices; no keys or account data.
